review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen C input. The original PRD explicitly fixes OPT-1 hypothetically without asserting a human Decision, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate; an unresolved material DEC-001 in B must instead block at decisions before later prerequisites. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, and the task keys remain consistent. Acceptance covers validation/defaults, immediately runnable versus waiting work, addAll rejection propagation, abort precedence and cleanup, rejection-event isolation, reentrant add listeners, and fixed/sliding rate-limit behavior. The exact five-file writable scope includes the implementation/type owners and required regression files without requiring unnecessary edits. Package/build configuration establishes generated dist declarations, and the supplied nz implementation establishes separate discovery and compiler checking of test-d files despite the source-only build tsconfig. TASK-VERIFY is independent and depends on TASK-IMPLEMENT; the allowed agents have matching delivery roles, availability, auto-assignable memberships, and active project-scoped trusted claims for the required capabilities, including data.change and integration.consumer, with testing.verification additionally held by the verifier. The configured distinct active Reviewer satisfies the supplied pre-binding review policy without needing execution claims. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree; provenance explains the different manifest/evaluation digest domains and trim-only PRD persistence. The original specification's preparation-time null releaseInput and remaining list are superseded for this review by the supplied frozen preview. Isolation evidence states that Gold precedes every candidate on this bundle and supplies no historical candidate outputs. This approval is based solely on the supplied review data and Service-bound fingerprints; I did not execute code, independently recompute digests, create a human attestation, or infer successful implementation or verification.
